sources.title: Hollywood Sign Trust: The Saga of the Sign (2018)
sources.facts: Current steel replacement erected in 1978. Published letter height 45 ft; 20 main support girders, horizontal supports and corrugated enameled sheet panels. Overall length reported as 450 ft conflicts with approximately 105 m mapped span; no artificial scale change applied.

sources.title: Hollywood Sign Trust: 2023—100 Years and Counting
sources.facts: 2022 repainting of the 45-foot-high sign confirms modern white surface treatment.

notes: Earlier imagery selection excluded as current control. Source factual dimensions/map/terrain records remain historical provenance; no Trust PDF illustrations used for new geometry. New support construction uses the exact clean CC0 rear original already in Qualla.

terrainComparison.replacement: USGS 3DEP GeoTIFF export, 2026-10-14; georeferenced bilinear sampling; terrain unchanged from the source. See terrain-grid.json for request, hash and sample matrix.
terrainComparison.panelAlignment: Photo-derived lower edges relative to Y: [-1.35,-1.35,-0.35,-0.15,0,0.2,0.3,0.55,0.3] m. Common level Y=1.8 m above sampled ground; values approximate the aerial photograph with 45 ft panel height, not a metric photogrammetric survey.
